authority: read-only source/configuration review; no Rust builds or tests started by this reviewer

recipe.unix_shell_adapter: scripts/just-shell.py -> sh -cu with positional arguments preserved

metadata_strategy: normal nextest full metadata path: no package selector means use_scoped_metadata returns false

selection.workspace_scope: all Cargo-resolved workspace members by virtual-workspace default, not merely literal members array length
selection.local_override: codex-app-server integration tests use group max-threads=4; default group max-threads=1
selection.feature_selection: Cargo default feature selection and normal unification; no --all-features or feature matrix requested
selection.target_selection: No --target; reported task nextest binary/host x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, inherited CARGO_BUILD_TARGET unset; actual Cargo target artifacts remain bound by final native receipts.

execution_policy.actual_app_server_parallel_limit_note: The group cap of 4 remains subject to the task global nextest pool of 2.

result_interpretation: Do not add stage test totals: later suites overlap earlier runs.
Report the full command, source tree, profile, target, passed/failed/skipped totals and original ignored identities from actual terminal evidence.
An ignored subprocess helper may be invoked by its non-ignored parent test; retain the original skip count and require the parent PASS/invocation evidence, without counting the child twice.
Tests compiled out by cfg or required features are absent from the discovered test list, not necessarily present in the skipped count.
A test function that returns early because a platform/service/permission prerequisite is unavailable can be reported as PASS by libtest; that alone does not qualify the omitted behavior.
The default workspace run does not prove all feature combinations, all operating systems, external live services, production GUI/media/model behavior or seven-role efficacy.

existing_helper_example.reason: worker is invoked only by owner_host_process_kill_reopen_matrix

environment_collection_limit: Only explicit runner and package/target selection noncredential keys requested; no complete environment or service credential values collected.

primary_semantics_sources.claim: Virtual workspace without default-members selects all members; in-workspace path dependencies can be members.
Default nextest execution runs all discovered non-ignored tests unless selection/default filters narrow it.
Ignored tests require explicit run-ignored; retries and no-fail-fast are runner policies; current nextest does not run doctests.

native_runner_confirmation.basis: native_validation independently reported SHA256/blob matches against bef in isolated full checkout; task-scoped nextest receipt independently read locally

limited_platform_service_examples.runtime_guard: An existing CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED_ENV_VAR presence check logs and returns before exercising the body.
limited_platform_service_examples.normal_execution: Uses wiremock::MockServer for /api/tags and /api/version; it does not launch a real Ollama model server.
limited_platform_service_examples.interpretation: A PASS can be an early return; even full normal execution here qualifies a mocked protocol interaction rather than a live external model deployment.

limited_platform_service_examples.windows_overrides: cfg(windows) overrides apply only on that platform; their presence does not turn this Linux invocation into Windows testing.
limited_platform_service_examples.opt_in_notes_timeout_comment: The preexisting Notes actual-app override only changes resource/timeout policy. Its comment alone does not prove the named live-app case is discovered, selected, or executed.

reviewer_actions.scope: Only this runner-scope audit; separately authorized Supervisor test import repair is documented in supervisor-restart-audit.
